items.title: Create a structured parent-test evidence intake
items.success_signal: The user can record setup time, engagement, quotes, confusion, mess, changes, and repeatability in one concise structured workflow, with no invented observations.
items.baseline: The field-test pack had a free-form log, but no reusable intake with mechanical checks for required observation fields or real-session attestation.
items.hypothesis: A concise reusable form plus a standard-library validator will reduce missing parent-test evidence without encouraging invented observations.
items.expected_effect: Future real sessions can produce reviewable evidence for one of the five declared activities; no live content or tested-status claim changes from this operator action.
items.observation_window: Not started. Evaluate usability after the user submits the first real completed intake.
items.decision: Create intake and validation only; keep every activity untested until real evidence is separately reviewed.
items.result: Added a reusable parent-test evidence intake, a validator for required fields and status/attestation consistency, and a test-pack handoff. Independent review cycle 3 returned PASS after closing incomplete-evidence and template-mode bypasses. No observation, child quote, photo, engagement result, tested status, site file, or public claim was created.
items.notes: Do not mark an activity tested or change a live claim without real user evidence and separate content review.

items.title: Release the reviewed parent-test workflow and cloud measurement setup
items.success_signal: The reviewed local commit and GSC infrastructure are on origin/main, the Pages workflow behavior is verified, and no activity is falsely presented as tested.
items.baseline: KAL-OPS-001 is review-clean in local commit e44954a but not on origin/main; the repository has no unattended GSC workflow or secret.
items.hypothesis: Releasing the reviewed intake plus a fail-loud, read-only GSC workflow will make evidence collection reproducible without changing public tested-status claims.
items.expected_effect: The parent-test workflow becomes durable on origin/main, Pages stops redeploying for snapshot-only commits, and GSC collection becomes operational once the required GitHub secret and property access are configured.
items.observation_window: No content observation window. Verify repository, workflow, and release state immediately after push.
items.decision: Push the review-clean commits under the standing 2026-07-17 authorization and verify GitHub Actions. Never mark an activity tested without real validated evidence.
items.production_verification: GitHub Pages run 29627141434 succeeded for the reviewed workflow release, and the live homepage byte-matched the committed site. Pages run 29627796105 then succeeded for the exact GSC/Pages infrastructure commit 046d840. The released commits contain no site or tested-status claim change. GSC workflow run 29627800627 succeeded with the restricted service account and committed the first validated snapshot in a782f62; the later snapshot and roadmap-only commits did not trigger Pages.
items.result: The reviewed parent-test workflow and unattended GSC infrastructure are on origin/main. The first real snapshot collected 29 impressions for the finalized 28-day window, confirmed a successful 61-page sitemap, and found all 7 priority URLs indexed.
items.notes: The fresh GSC snapshot establishes the KAL-MON-001 baseline; wait for a changed validated snapshot before evidence review. No activity may be described as tested without real validated parent evidence.

items.title: Install the activity-cluster research and persona-review operating model
items.success_signal: Current guidance consistently makes the Control Room the sole scheduler and the Master the single repository writer, requires source-derived persona hypotheses and SERP-overlap decisions before implementation, and defines independent severity-based review without changing any public page.
items.baseline: Kid Activity Lab has strong tired-parent and parent-test rules, but active guidance still mixes old child-chat ownership with the Control Room model and lacks a reusable activity-cluster decision protocol, persona traceability, and a dedicated independent reviewer charter.
items.hypothesis: A KAL-specific adaptation of the proven Family Tripwise research and review model will make future page changes more evidence-driven, persona-useful, and reviewable without weakening the real parent-test gate.
items.expected_effect: The next age-4 research transaction can produce one auditable decision pack and at most one implementation recommendation; no page, activity claim, tested status, indexing request, external account, or deployment changes here.
items.observation_window: Not applicable to governance. Evaluate the model during the first age-4 cluster decision pack and first page implementation.
items.decision: Install protocols, templates, active role boundaries, and durable review rules only. Keep KAL-IMP-001 blocked until a separate research transaction selects one evidence-supported page.
items.gsc_evidence_classification: The validated 2026-07-28 public-safe snapshot has finalized data through 2026-07-26: 72 impressions, 0 clicks, 61 discovered pages, and 7 of 7 priority URLs indexed. The ramp article has 24 page-level impressions, but complete query rows remain unavailable; this supports monitoring context, not a content edit.
items.result: Installed the KAL-specific activity-cluster research protocol, persona/every-section review protocol, decision-pack template, independent reviewer charter, and single-writer role boundaries. Review cycle 1 found three P2 consistency/reproducibility gaps and two P3 notes; cycle 2 verified every finding closed and returned PASS with no P0-P3 findings. Released push-only in f9917a298f5e4526f93e959844c8975c999e0f9c with local main aligned to origin/main. No public page, generator, GSC snapshot, parent/child evidence, indexing, external account, or deployment path changed.
items.notes: Selected by direct manual user instruction. Push-only governance transaction; no site, generator, GSC snapshot, parent observation, child quote, photo, indexing, external account, or deployment path is authorized. Its Control Room-only scheduler rule was superseded by KAL-OPS-003 after the user selected chat-led manual operation.

items.title: Switch to chat-led execution and risk-based commit cadence
items.success_signal: Active guidance makes this Master chat the current command center, treats Control Room scheduling as paused future automation, removes the fixed daily substantive-action cap, and preserves one registered action per transaction plus exact scope without overlapping active work, QA, independent review, release, and production verification gates.
items.baseline: The reviewed operating model makes the central Control Room the only scheduler and limits the project to one substantive commit per day, which prevents the user from directing multiple separately scoped, reviewed transactions from this Master chat.
items.hypothesis: A chat-led manual phase with risk-based batching can move faster without sacrificing evidence, scope, review, or release integrity.
items.expected_effect: The Master chat may complete multiple sequential transactions when each has a registered action, exact paths that do not overlap another active transaction or unrelated dirty work, green QA, independent review when material, and verified release evidence.
items.observation_window: Review after the first two chat-led substantive transactions or before re-enabling Control Room automation.
items.decision: Remove the fixed daily cap and pause Control Room scheduling for Kid Activity Lab. Keep one action per transaction, a single repository writer, evidence and human gates, exact-path commits, independent review, and release verification.
items.result: Switched active project guidance to this permanent Master chat, removed the fixed daily substantive-action and commit cap, archived the stale multi-writer cadence, and preserved transaction, scope, evidence, QA, review, and release gates. Central commit ad14e5946e832d77ee6d5844bcf5fe35fd697c25 changed only Kid Activity Lab lifecycle from active to paused; the controller now classifies it as paused with no scheduled work. Review cycle 1 found one P1 operational-pause gap, one P2 stale-cadence conflict, and two P3 history notes. Cycle 2 verified every finding closed and returned PASS with no P0-P3 findings.
items.notes: Selected by direct manual user instruction. Governance-only transaction; no site, generator, GSC snapshot, indexing, external account, parent/child evidence, or deployment path is authorized. The central repository contained unrelated dirty and untracked work, which was preserved outside the exact portfolio-file commit.

items.title: Build the age-4 activity cluster decision pack
items.success_signal: One research-only decision pack classifies the age-4 and constraint-led query families by observed SERP overlap, derives four to six traceable persona hypotheses, audits every relevant page and visible section, and promotes at most one bounded existing-page implementation.
items.evidence_classification: Latest GSC aggregate, page, and priority-inspection rows are MEASURED. Public-safe query rows are UNKNOWN. Current public SERPs and ranking pages are SOURCE_BACKED research inputs; any personas or page-intent inferences are RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS. Keyword volume, KD, and CPC remain UNKNOWN unless a current named tool source is available without unapproved spend.
items.human_gate: No validated parent-test intake or original visual is in scope. The research may identify those as blockers but may not create or imply parent/child observations, quotes, safety outcomes, tested status, or original photography.
items.decision: Promote one existing-page improvement for the cardboard ramp article. Preserve its build-and-troubleshoot ownership, add a compact source-backed one-variable test route, and remove or relabel unsupported tested, duration, child-capability, cleanup, and safety-outcome language. Do not create a new page.
items.result: Built a source-dated decision pack covering 17 query variants, five incomplete but reproducibly limited SERP samples, representative ranking pages, five source-traced parent-job hypotheses, eight current KAL pages, and every visible section of the three implementation candidates. The strongest measured foothold is the existing cardboard ramp article at 24 impressions and average position 16.58; current complete query rows, clicks, validated parent tests, and original visuals remain unavailable. A different read-only research agent independently recommended the same existing-page evidence-integrity improvement.
items.notes: Selected by direct manual user instruction after KAL-OPS-003. Research-only transaction. Do not edit site or generator paths, create pages, infer query intent from public-safe page rows, use paid tools without explicit budget authorization, or treat persona hypotheses as parent-test evidence.
